systems.system: Education Management Information System (EMIS) at MEPPSA, established by Decree No. 2023-1751 of 2 November 2023
systems.tiers: central; school census data and statistical yearbooks, read annually for the Program's indicators

systems.system: Integrated EMIS for all education ministries (planned under TRESOR, DLI 6)
systems.owner: MEPPSA, MESRIT, METP and MJSECFQE; World Bank and GPE financing tied to results
systems.tiers: not yet available at appraisal; defined as a connected platform bringing together data and indicators from the education ministries, with statistical yearbooks and department dashboards
to be built from school census, biometric enrolment, retirement and teacher mobility data

note: The appraisal (28 May 2024) describes the existing EMIS as school census data and yearbooks and the planned integrated EMIS as a platform assembling ministries' data and indicators, with its baseline stated as no integrated EMIS available; nothing describes schools entering records per learner, so the systems are class census and give no fact.
